## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle commentary on the *[Guān wú liàng shòu fó jīng T0365](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0071)* is by [慧遠](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E9%81%A0) *Jìngyǐng Huìyuǎn* (523–592). It is the foundational Pure Land commentary in the Chinese tradition — the work studied by Tanaka 1990 as the doctrinal "dawn" of mature Chinese Pure Land Buddhism.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (580 – 592) reflects [慧遠](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E9%81%A0) *Jìngyǐng Huìyuǎn*'s mature Suí period.
